highlights: Agentic AI systems are rapidly evolving, with new frameworks enabling more governable multi-LLM collaborations and cost-effective simulation of large agent societies.
Frontier models are pushing boundaries with significant performance gains, specialized applications for critical domains like cybersecurity, and new open-source multimodal releases.
The ecosystem for AI builders is expanding with integrated development platforms for agents, advanced prompt optimization techniques, and broader cloud availability of frontier models.

agents.title: Dynamic Governance of Multi-LLM Agent Systems
agents.summary: This research introduces the Experience Orchestrator (EO), a control-theoretic governance layer that significantly improves collaborative outcomes in multi-LLM agent systems by providing a missing shared goal function, enabling more effective visitor guidance in simulated financial services.

agents.title: Poor Man's Agentic Modeling: Simulating Large LLM-Agent Societies on a Laptop
agents.summary: This paper presents a method to simulate large LLM-agent societies affordably on a laptop by replacing full LLM agents with low-parameter models fitted from cheaper queries, making large-scale agent research and development accessible without extensive compute resources.

agents.title: LLMs in Process Diagram Engineering: From Optimal PFDs to Validated P&IDs
agents.summary: P&ID Pilot is introduced as an end-to-end AI pipeline combining genetic algorithms and LLMs to automate the creation and validation of process flow and piping and instrumentation diagrams, enabling significant reductions in manual engineering effort for industrial design.

models.title: Previewing Ultrafast mode: GPT-5.6 Sol at up to 14X the speed
models.summary: OpenAI is previewing "Ultrafast" mode for GPT-5.6 Sol, offering up to 14 times faster generation speeds (750 output tokens/second) powered by Cerebras, enabling developers to build highly responsive AI applications.

models.title: Meta is back with Muse Glimmer: local, agentic, multimodal, and open source
models.summary: Meta has released Muse Glimmer, an open-source, local, agentic, and multimodal model, empowering developers with full control and flexibility to build advanced AI applications that process and generate various types of data on-device.

models.title: Expanding Daybreak as the Cyber Defense Window Narrows: Meet GPT-5.6-Cyber
models.summary: OpenAI introduces GPT-5.6-Cyber, a specialized cybersecurity model available through Daybreak Red for authorized vulnerability research, exploit validation, and security testing, providing advanced AI capabilities for cyber defense.

tools.title: Gemini API Managed Agents: 3.6 Flash, hooks, and more
tools.summary: Google announces new capabilities for Managed Agents in Gemini API, including 3.6 Flash and hooks, to help developers build reliable, production-ready AI agents with enhanced control and flexibility.

tools.title: Record, train, and deploy from one place with Strands Agents, LeRobot, and Hugging Face Storage Buckets
tools.summary: This integrated offering provides a unified platform for recording robot data, training LeRobot models, and deploying Strands Agents using Hugging Face Storage Buckets, streamlining the entire lifecycle of agent development and deployment.

tools.title: From Monolithic to Modular: Segment-level Automatic Prompt Optimization (SAPO)
tools.summary: SAPO introduces a segment-level automatic prompt optimization method that decomposes prompts into components for targeted improvements, leading to superior and more robust performance for LLMs across various tasks compared to monolithic optimization.

companies.title: Daybreak models are now available on AWS
companies.summary: OpenAI's Daybreak cybersecurity capabilities, including frontier cyber models, are now available through Amazon Bedrock, enabling enterprises to integrate advanced AI security workflows directly within their AWS environments.

companies.title: AMIE, our research medical AI system, demonstrates real-time clinical video consultation capabilities in a first-of-its-kind study.
companies.summary: Google's AMIE research medical AI system has demonstrated real-time clinical video consultation capabilities in simulated environments, marking a significant step towards practical AI assistance in healthcare diagnostics and patient interaction.

companies.title: From assistance to execution: How enterprises put AI to work
companies.summary: OpenAI research highlights how leading enterprises are shifting beyond basic AI assistance to implementing agentic AI for execution, demonstrating a growing trend in leveraging AI to automate complex tasks and drive operational efficiency.

learning.title: The builder’s guide to GPT‑5.6
learning.summary: OpenAI has released a comprehensive guide for developers to learn how to effectively utilize GPT-5.6, offering insights into building faster, more cost-efficient AI agents with smarter model selection and new Responses API capabilities.

learning.title: Inside our 353,000-person vibe coding course
learning.summary: Google and Kaggle successfully hosted a no-cost "AI Agents Intensive" course, attracting over 353,000 learners to build and deploy advanced AI agents, fostering a massive community of AI developers.

learning.title: What We Learned by Reproducing 2,200 papers from ICML
learning.summary: Hugging Face shares critical insights gained from reproducing 2,200 ICML papers, providing valuable lessons on reproducibility and practical challenges in machine learning research for the wider AI community.
